reply: That exact wording is the old message, from before the fix (decision cloud-start-hooks-run-fresh, Nov 3). Main's check now finds the binary another way and says nothing. Two cases still show it. (1) A cloud session from an environment snapshot built before the fix: its stale start-up hook runs first and prints the old line. Each session from that snapshot shows it, new or old, until the snapshot is rebuilt (page item cloud-snapshot-rebuild). (2) A resumed old session that still runs its old hook copy. This session (cloud, started today) has CLAUDE_CODE_EXECPATH set to /opt/claude-code/bin/claude. Mac sessions link their hooks to the clone, so they follow your Mac checkout.
